title: A Salt for the Veil
author: Wren Villalobos
blurb: Ada Reyes, an exiled storm-caller, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
